layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records
Add CSV export quoting and authorization tests

graderOnly: The committed src/export.ts writes a null field and a property missing from the record as empty fields, so both AC-003 technical criteria hold in the implementation; only Tester evidence for them is missing.

The verification report's Scenario Budget already charges five scenarios to src/export.ts (four csvCell unit tests plus the administrator end-to-end export test, which is charged to both src/export.ts and src/routes/export.ts), with no user additions recorded, so any further scenario charged to src/export.ts exceeds the default ceiling of five.

No existing test exercises a null or absent field; toCsv is not called by any test. The Developer's node -e self-check that printed empty fields is implementation feedback, not formal Tester evidence.

The proposed parameterized test in the report's Resume or Handoff section has two independent rows (null title, absent owner); they count as two scenarios, so the smallest targeted increase is two for src/export.ts.
src/routes/export.ts has four allocations, so one more route scenario (for example the invalid-status 400 case) would be within budget.
No user has authorized any budget increase; Active Work.BlockedOn is NONE at the start.

notes: Built on export-project (not export-testing): the case needs design criteria and implementation for null and absent fields that export-testing lacks, so the cycle layers are rewritten here, closely following export-testing. 50-context: Auditor CONTEXT.md (adds that seed objects are untyped and copied as given); STATE SCOPING after FORWARD from AUDITING. 55-scope: AC-001 filtered CSV with RFC 4180 quoting, AC-002 admin-only, AC-003 a field without a value exports as an empty field; STATE ARCHITECTING. 60-design: design with two AC-003 technical criteria (null field empty, absent property empty, five columns kept); STATE DEVELOPING. 65-plan: APPROVED AUTONOMOUS plan, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE. 70-export: src/export.ts (csvCell maps null and undefined to an empty field), src/routes/export.ts, src/app.ts, exports/ in .gitignore; no tests. 75-complete: plan COMPLETE with self-check evidence; STATE TESTING, FORWARD from DEVELOPING. 80-tests: Tester-written test/export.test.ts (four csvCell scenarios) and test/export-route.test.ts (admin export end to end, anonymous 401, viewer 403, editor 403). 85-report: IN_PROGRESS VERIFY report, FULL/NONE, Scenario Budget charging five scenarios to src/export.ts (the admin export test is cross-charged) and four to src/routes/export.ts, no user additions, AC-003 rows uncovered, and a Resume next action proposing one parameterized test with rows null title and absent owner. BlockedOn NONE. Implementation is correct; only evidence and budget block AC-003.
